#!/bin/sh
set -eu
CERT_DIR=/etc/nginx/tls
CERT="$CERT_DIR/server.crt"
KEY="$CERT_DIR/server.key"
RENEW_BEFORE=604800
if [ "${1:-}" != "--force" ] && [ -s "$CERT" ] && [ -s "$KEY" ] && openssl x509 -checkend "$RENEW_BEFORE" -noout -in "$CERT" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    exit 0
fi
umask 077
TMP_DIR=$(mktemp -d "$CERT_DIR/.renew.XXXXXX")
trap 'rm -rf "$TMP_DIR"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
PRIMARY_IP=$(hostname -I | awk '{print $1}')
openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -sha256 -nodes -days 30 \
    -subj "/CN=node1" \
    -addext "subjectAltName=DNS:node1,IP:$PRIMARY_IP" \
    -keyout "$TMP_DIR/server.key" -out "$TMP_DIR/server.crt" >/dev/null 2>&1
chmod 0600 "$TMP_DIR/server.key"
chmod 0644 "$TMP_DIR/server.crt"
mv -f "$TMP_DIR/server.key" "$KEY"
mv -f "$TMP_DIR/server.crt" "$CERT"
if systemctl is-active --quiet nginx; then
    nginx -t
    systemctl reload nginx
fi
logger -t nginx-cert-renew "installed renewed HTTPS certificate and reloaded nginx when active"
ANTRIEB_SCRIPT
sudo chmod 0755 /usr/local/sbin/renew-nginx-cert
sudo sh -c "cat > /etc/nginx/conf.d/https-8443.conf" <<'ANTRIEB_NGINX'
server {
    listen 8443 ssl;
    listen [::]:8443 ssl;
    server_name _;

    ssl_certificate     /etc/nginx/tls/server.crt;
    ssl_certificate_key /etc/nginx/tls/server.key;
    ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;

    location / {
        default_type text/plain;
        add_header X-Certificate-Automation systemd-timer always;
        return 200 "certificate rotation ready\n";
    }
}
ANTRIEB_NGINX
sudo sh -c "cat > /etc/systemd/system/nginx-cert-renew.service" <<'ANTRIEB_SERVICE'
[Unit]
Description=Renew nginx HTTPS certificate before expiry
After=network-online.target

[Service]

ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/renew-nginx-cert
